saints.name: St. Francis Xavier
saints.title: Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A companion of Ignatius Loyola and the greatest missionary since the Apostles, who carried the Gospel to India and Japan…
biography: Born in the castle of Xavier in Navarre in 1506, Francis was won for God at the University of Paris by St. Ignatius of Loyola and became one of the first Jesuits. Sent to the East as papal legate, he labored from 1542 among the peoples of India, the Malay archipelago, and Japan, baptizing many thousands and founding enduring Christian communities.

Worn out by his travels, he died in 1552 on the island of Shangchuan within sight of the coast of China, which he had longed to enter. He is honored as the patron of the missions and of all who carry the Gospel to distant lands.
saints.knownFor: The Apostle of the Indies and of Japan.

sources.text: Butler, Lives of the Saints (1866 ed.), 3 December
